purpose: Replace the independently rejected full-K3 dual-state prediction target with a smaller physically distinct target: after one exact zero-start CGLS step, predict only the detector-space correction needed to reach the K4 solution, lift it once with the exact adjoint, and choose its scalar from the deployment-visible K1 residual.
scientific_question: Does a K1-residual-conditioned detector-dual correction have exact K4 capacity under a 2A+2A^T deployment budget, and is any apparent capacity already explained by a cheaper deterministic residual control?
claim_boundary: This is a post-open mechanism diagnostic on synthetic straight-ray BOS observations generated from public PoolFire CFD. Exact-teacher capacity is not a learned result. It is not fresh or external validation, curved-ray evidence, experimental BOST evidence, a resource speedup, broad generalization, an algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.

negative_parent_decision.mechanism_interpretation: The exact two-dual representation has K4 capacity, but the 11504-parameter set model cannot reliably predict both complete K3 dual states on held-out trajectories; observation-error tails dominate. Close that representation without larger CNN, FNO, UNO or U-Net rescue.

data_contract.camera_set_contract: Each camera is an independent set element carrying a 2x16x16 observation and an 18-value reported pose token. Camera order may change and cameras may be added or removed through a mask.

exact_teacher.definition: Run zero-start CGLS to K1 and K4 on the identical noisy observation and reported geometry. Let z1 and z4 be their natural detector duals and define delta_z=z4-z1, so A^T delta_z=x4-x1.
exact_teacher.capacity_shell: From exact K1 compute h=A^T delta_z and p=A h, choose alpha=<r1,p>/<p,p>, and return x1+alpha h. The deployment ledger is 2A+2A^T including K1.

cheap_deterministic_controls.decision: If any 2A+2A^T control passes every trajectory and metric tail, the learned correction is not authorized because the same budget already has a deterministic explanation.

accuracy_gate.grouping: each complete trajectory separately over all 740 camera-set/noise/pose cells

conditional_model_gate.authorized_only_if: exact teacher passes all 3700 parity cells and no deterministic 2A+2A^T control passes the full trajectory-wise accuracy gate
conditional_model_gate.input: deployment-visible K1 residual as an unordered padded camera set, matching 18-value reported pose tokens and camera mask
conditional_model_gate.output: one co-permuting detector-space correction dual delta_z
required_properties: no truth, future frame or trajectory identity input
conditional_model_gate.outer_rule: five complete-trajectory leave-one-out folds with all preprocessing fit only on the other four trajectories
conditional_model_gate.failure_action: Close this residual-correction representation without a larger CNN, FNO, UNO or U-Net rescue.

required_inputs: multi-camera displacement images with stable camera IDs
per-camera intrinsics and extrinsics with coordinate convention
repeat acquisitions or an accepted noise estimate
laboratory-approved reconstruction baseline and stopping rule
future_experimental_transfer.rule: Keep a clean baseline and independently inject observation noise, camera rotation/translation/focal/principal-point perturbations and camera add/drop/reordering during CFD development. When experimental data arrive, reproduce its measured noise and calibration uncertainty rather than retuning on test truth.
